shipLog.text: ◆ STATION ARRIVAL — brought to you by StationMart™! 'Your needs, met at markup!' CHIP is contractually required to be excited about stations. He is.
◆ Planting registered! Your crop's warranty begins NOW and covers nothing! Nature has never accepted liability!
NOW ARRIVING: Asteroid Field 1! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at The Paperwork: “Sign everything without reading”! BOLD leadership!
You signed. RESULTS: +5 MORALE, 1 DAY! ★★★★★
◆ Entering the field! Every rock here is a potential mining claim! CHIP has filed on all of them! Please do not hit CHIP's property!
NOW ARRIVING: Route Decision! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Both Lanes Watched: “Run the storm: starboard lane”! BOLD leadership!
You take the storm. RESULTS: −10 HULL, −2 MORALE, 1 DAY. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
NOW ARRIVING: Nebula (beta)! Trip cost: −5 FOOD, −4 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 11 DAYS. RATE your journey!
◆ The ship computer files a reference: nebulae look solid from far away, but most are thinner than the best vacuum a lab on Earth can make.
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Visibility Zero: “Crawl through at a quarter speed”! BOLD leadership!
You creep through the glow for four long days, watching the… RESULTS: −2 FUEL, 4 DAYS. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
◆ Thanks for accepting our Terms without reading them! Most people do, and our Legal team adores every one of them!
GROWBAY UPDATE: Soybean hit VEGETATIVE! 30% grown, health 99. INVEST!
NOW ARRIVING: Nebula (beta)! Trip cost: −4 FOOD, −3 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, −1 O2, 10 DAYS. RATE your journey!
CAPTAIN’S CHOICE at Mayday, Faintly: “Answer it. Burn hard”! BOLD leadership!
You pull them out of their dying rig with forty minutes of… RESULTS: −6 FUEL, +5 MORALE, 4 DAYS. ★★☆☆☆ Rate us anyway!
◆ A nebula! CHIP once tried to buy advertising space on one! The light-diffusion made the logo ILLEGIBLE! Nature is hostile to branding!
NOW ARRIVING: Port Authority (Disputed)! Trip cost: −5 FOOD, −4 H2O, −2 FUEL, +1 MORALE, 11 DAYS. RATE your journey!
Also: −1 O2.
